purpose: Expose the canonical registered coverage reference through the existing authorized decision-controls forecast reader.
semanticGuards: No new endpoint, producer, mutation, finance calculation, authority grant, manifest or policy change.
Optional forecast.coverage is absent only when the existing classification is absent; expectedVersion zero still requires the existing authorized absence observation and its recheck.
Present classification or coverage read failures propagate their tagged PortResult; no empty fallback or optimistic expectedVersion is exposed.
Canonical coverage is resolved by runtime.domain.baselineCoverage.resolveForecastCoverage(source.refId, call), never computed by the client.
Source, case identity/incarnation, non-future case revision, exact basis, assessment basis/revision/currency/horizon and classified entries must agree.
The forecast comparison must already contain the same canonical coverage reference; a read spanning registration or replacement returns stale.
A second authorized classification read must equal the first; existing presence recheck, outer case recheck and authority revalidation remain in place.
Projection is not recomputed: the existing compareForecast producer already rechecks source and coverage; canonical comparison reference matching binds the returned coverage to that observation.

validation.performed: Static producer-contract inspection and preimage/artifact hashing only.
validation.integratorRequired: Session14 must reconcile its current producer blob before applying this optional seam, then include it in the already authorized surgical GitHub Actions validation.
